remarks_post_1999: This work was not examined at the time of the Lynes publication. Title, date, and medium Canna Lily, 1919 by Georgia O’Keeffe, oil on board, and dimensions as 12 x 9 based on backing inscription, installation photographs from the Anderson Galleries 1923 exhibition, and 2012 technical examination done by Dale Kronkright at the Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. It is possible that this work is listed in Appendix II as no. 18 or 39 as a recording error could have been made at the time of the Whitney Archive or Abiquiú Notebooks. It’s also possible that it is neither and is not recorded in Lynes, 1999. (Source: Georgia O'Keeffe Museum, 2025)
